Res.Caption: Customer Service Ticket
Res.FullDescription: A request for assistance or work from a client.

Res.Caption: Ticket Number
Res.FullDescription: The unique number associated with this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Summary
Res.FullDescription: A brief summary of the Ticket.

Res.Caption: Description
Res.FullDescription: A longer description of the Ticket.

Res.Caption: Client
Res.FullDescription: The client who raised this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Branch
Res.FullDescription: The branch which is handling this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Department
Res.FullDescription: The department which is handling this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Country/Region
Res.FullDescription: The country/region associated with this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Selection Criterion 1
Res.FullDescription: The first criterion for deciding which Workflow Template to use for this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Selection Criterion 2
Res.FullDescription: The second criterion for deciding which Workflow Template to use for this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Selection Criterion 3
Res.FullDescription: The third criterion for deciding which Workflow Template to use for this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Selection Criterion 4
Res.FullDescription: The fourth criterion for deciding which Workflow Template to use for this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Selection Criterion 5
Res.FullDescription: The fifth criterion for deciding which Workflow Template to use for this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Create Time (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The time (in UTC) at which this Ticket was created.

Res.Caption: Create User
Res.FullDescription: The user who created this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Last Edit Time (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The time (in UTC) at which this Ticket was most recently edited.

Res.Caption: Last Edit User
Res.FullDescription: The user who most recently edited this Ticket.

Res.Caption: Status
Res.FullDescription: The status of this ticket, which is indicative of the status of its tasks and related Work Items.
